items.title: Richard Keys replaced by glamorous London 2012 Olympic medallist as new face of beIN Sports after 13 years
items.summary: KAYLYN KYLE is the new face of football at beIN Sports - after replacing Richard Keys. The former midfielder, 37, featured for the Rest of the World at Soccer Aid in June. And Kyle announced her abrupt exit from Apple TV's coverage of Major League Soccer in an emotional statement earlier this month.
